item.title: Seven Killed in Head-on Collision on Quetta-Taftan Highway
item.description: Seven people, including five women, were killed and four others sustained critical injuries on Tuesday in a head-on collision near the Yakmach area of Chagai district. The accident occurred on the Quetta-Taftan National Highway when two vehicles traveling at high speeds collided head-on.
